claim: Reset does not reopen the original path edit when state.scene was already null, since the reset notification only fires on a stored-scene change to null

triage.scenario: User leaves the canvas's default path edit without editing a scene node, so state.scene stays null; reset leaves it null, the effect sees no change, and TrialSceneCanvas never reopens the original path
triage.cause: reset signaled via scene-value change instead of an explicit reset event

claim: A Reset or outside load of a scene that has history writes a scene with no nodes into the trial's state
`sceneTrialHistory.restore` throws `ExtensionConflictError` on every restore after the first on the same scene
The scene's trial history has no `clear`, so a Reset over a scene not owned by `useTrialScene` keeps stale settings entries
